    ],
)
def test_camel_to_snake_happy_path(value: str, expected: str) -> None:
    assert camel_to_snake(value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(

    [
        pytest.param("", "", id="empty-string"),
        pytest.param("a", "a", id="single-lowercase-char"),

        pytest.param("lowercase", "lowercase", id="all-lowercase"),

def test_camel_to_snake_edge_cases(value: str, expected: str) -> None:
